content: {"episode_id":"ep-05004","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management."}
